title: Outstanding Step on Long-Overdue Entrance Fee Agreement Refunds
content:
For an **Entrance Fee Agreement** refund paid after its due date, the outstanding step adds to the campus rate for a refund long past due: 270 or more days past the due date add 0.5 percentage points, 90 to 269 days add 0.25 percentage points, and fewer days add nothing; the campus rate and the step are added together before they are applied.

Days past the due date are the calendar days from the refund due date fixed on the agreement to the day the refund is paid.

## Step ladder

| Days past the refund due date | Outstanding step |
|---|---|
| 270 or more | 0.5 percentage points |
| 90 to 269 | 0.25 percentage points |
| Fewer than 90 | None |

## Boundaries

| Days past due | Step |
|---|---|
| 270 | 0.5 |
| 269 | 0.25 |
| 90 | 0.25 |
| 89 | None |

## Hypothetical combinations

| Campus rate (as given) | Days past due | Rate applied per year |
|---|---|---|
| 8.0 | 300 | 8.5 |
| 9.0 | 120 | 9.25 |
| 0 | 120 | 0.25 |
| 8.0 | 45 | 8.0 |
